audio_creation_notes.music: Source options: (1) License from Epidemic Sound, Artlist, or similar (must support 110-120 BPM indie/lo-fi); (2) commission original from composer; (3) use royalty-free from Unsplash Music, Pixabay Music, or YouTube Audio Library. Ensure license permits commercial use.
audio_creation_notes.sfx: Compile from Freesound, Epidemic Sound, or standard SFX libraries. Export as MP3, -6dB to -12dB mix level. SFX cues provided above for timing reference.
